import Mathlib.Algebra.MonoidAlgebra.Degree
import Mathlib.Algebra.MvPolynomial.Eval
import Mathlib.Order.ConditionallyCompleteLattice.Finset
import Mathlib.Basic.Real.Basic
import Mathlib.Data.Finsupp.Weight
import Mathlib.RingTheory.MvPowerSeries.NoZeroDivisors
import Mathlib.Tactic
#check_failure Roth.index
#check @AddMonoidAlgebra.infDegree
#check @Finset.inf'_eq_csInf_image
#check @Finset.coe_inf'
#check @MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder
#check @MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder_mul
#check @MvPolynomial.coeff_coe
#check @Finsupp.sum_fintype
namespace IndexMathlibOnly133
open MvPolynomial
universe u v
noncomputable def indexViaInfDegree {σ : Type u} {R : Type v} [CommSemiring R]
    (P : MvPolynomial σ R) (α : σ → R) (w : (σ →₀ ℕ) → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (AddMonoidAlgebra.infDegree (fun d ↦ (w d : WithTop ℝ))
    (aeval (fun j ↦ X j + C (α j)) P)).untopD 0
noncomputable def expandedIndex {σ : Type u} {R : Type v} [CommSemiring R]
    (P : MvPolynomial σ R) (α : σ → R) (w : (σ →₀ ℕ) → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  sInf (w '' ((aeval (fun j ↦ X j + C (α j)) P).support : Set (σ →₀ ℕ)))
theorem finsetBridge {ι : Type u} (s : Finset ι) (w : ι → ℝ) :
    (s.inf (fun d ↦ (w d : WithTop ℝ))).untopD 0 =
      sInf (w '' (s : Set ι)) := by
  classical
  rcases s.eq_empty_or_nonempty with h | h
  · subst s
    simp
  · change (s.inf (WithTop.some ∘ w)).untopD 0 = _
    rw [← Finset.coe_inf' h w, Finset.inf'_eq_csInf_image]
    rfl
theorem genericBridge {σ : Type u} {R : Type v} [CommSemiring R]
    (P : MvPolynomial σ R) (α : σ → R) (w : (σ →₀ ℕ) → ℝ) :
    indexViaInfDegree P α w = expandedIndex P α w :=
  finsetBridge _ _
#print axioms finsetBridge
#print axioms genericBridge
#print axioms indexViaInfDegree
#print axioms expandedIndex
noncomputable def denominatorIndex {σ : Type u} {R : Type v} [CommSemiring R]
    (P : MvPolynomial σ R) (α : σ → R) (r : σ → ℕ) : ℝ :=
  (AddMonoidAlgebra.infDegree
    (fun d : σ →₀ ℕ ↦ (Finsupp.weight (R := ℕ) (fun j ↦ (r j : ℝ)⁻¹) d : WithTop ℝ))
    (aeval (fun j ↦ X j + C (α j)) P)).untopD 0
theorem denominatorBridge {σ : Type u} {R : Type v} [CommSemiring R]
    (P : MvPolynomial σ R) (α : σ → R) (r : σ → ℕ) :
    denominatorIndex P α r = expandedIndex P α
      (fun d : σ →₀ ℕ ↦ d.sum fun j n ↦ (n : ℝ) * (r j : ℝ)⁻¹) := by
  simpa only [denominatorIndex, indexViaInfDegree, Finsupp.weight_apply, nsmul_eq_mul]
    using genericBridge P α (fun d : σ →₀ ℕ ↦ d.sum fun j n ↦ (n : ℝ) * (r j : ℝ)⁻¹)
#print axioms denominatorIndex
#print axioms denominatorBridge
end IndexMathlibOnly133

@AddMonoidAlgebra.infDegree : {R : Type u_1} →
  {A : Type u_2} →
    {T : Type u_3} →
      [inst : Semiring R] → [inst_1 : SemilatticeInf T] → [OrderTop T] → (A → T) → AddMonoidAlgebra R A → T

@Finset.inf'_eq_csInf_image : ∀ {ι : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} [inst : ConditionallyCompleteLattice α] (s : Finset ι)
  (H : s.Nonempty) (f : ι → α), s.inf' H f = sInf (f '' ↑s)

@Finset.coe_inf' : ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [inst : SemilatticeInf α] {s : Finset β} (H : s.Nonempty)
  (f : β → α), ↑(s.inf' H f) = s.inf (WithTop.some ∘ f)
@MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder : {σ : Type u_1} → {R : Type u_2} → [Semiring R] → (σ → ℕ) → MvPowerSeries σ R → ℕ∞

@MvPolynomial.coeff_coe : ∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] (φ : MvPolynomial σ R) (n : σ →₀ ℕ),
  (MvPowerSeries.coeff n) ↑φ = φ.coeff n

@Finsupp.sum_fintype : ∀ {α : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} {N : Type u_3} [inst : Zero M] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid N]
  [inst_2 : Fintype α] (f : α →₀ M) (g : α → M → N), (∀ (i : α), g i 0 = 0) → f.sum g = ∑ i, g i (f i)
